Subject: Packaging questions for BrightApps (mid-market)

Hi Diego —

Thanks for the demo last week. We loved the latency numbers on the dedicated plan, but our finance team is looking closely at packaging. A few quick asks so we can move to procurement: 

- Can you outline an upgrade path from Starter -> Pro -> Dedicated (esp. how seat counts and token caps move)?
- We expect seasonal spikes; is there a simple downgrade path if we need to trim back after Q4?
- Any recommended bundling to get vector search + reranking without paying for full Dedicated yet?

If you can share a compact matrix (features vs tiers + estimated list pricing + any common discounts for mid-market), that would be ideal. We may need a short-term pilot with credits and a two-quarter commit.

Cheers,
Alyssa

Subject: Re: Packaging questions for BrightApps (mid-market)

Hi Alyssa —

Great questions — thanks for laying them out. I put together a one-page matrix attached that maps Starter/Pro/Dedicated along the axes you asked about (seats, token caps, peak burst, feature toggles). High-level:

- Starter: good for low-volume experimentation; not recommended for production reranking or heavy embedding workloads.
- Pro: includes embeddings + reranking add-on; recommended if you want predictable per-token pricing without reserved GPUs. Can autoscale but cost varies with burst.
- Dedicated: reserved GPU pools, fixed throughput, recommended when you need tight latency SLAs and predictable unit cost.

Downgrade path: Customers commonly use a 30-day notice and a prorated seat/token adjustment; we allow one mid-term stepdown per 12-month commit without penalty (we document this in the SOW).

Bundling tip: If you want vector search + reranking but aren’t ready for Dedicated, suggest Pro + embeddings seat bundle with an add-on token cap. That avoids the Dedicated minimum while giving consistent model quality.

I attached packaging_matrix_v2.xlsx and a draft mid-market quote. Neha — looped you in for pricing/discount guidance.

— Diego
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Thanks Diego — reviewed the matrix. Quick notes for the commercial ask: 

- For mid-market (BrightApps profile) we can offer a 12-month Pro bundle with an embeddings + rerank add-on at list minus 15% with a $30k minimum commit. That gives them predictable unit costs and includes one free canary rollout.
- If they want Dedicated within the first 90 days, we can convert and credit 50% of the initial commit against a 12-month Dedicated contract.
- Downgrade terms: allow a single 20% seat reduction after month 6; further reductions require renewal or an exception.

I’ve flagged this to Finance for an exception on the 15% if they push for more. Priyom — can you review and indicate approval for up to 20% off for strategic pilots?

Neha
